name: UVtools
description: The retained UVtools UI integrates the external Updatum package, checks for updates at startup when configured, and sets macOS code-signing validation in its manager configuration. Payload verification and released-artifact behavior remain delegated to the unvendored dependency and release pipeline.
limitations: Newly recovered default-branch snapshot, not historical release re-verification.
Updatum package source, generated release metadata, non-macOS validation, and released artifact provenance were not audited.
